name: Vlyublyonnaya Emma
source:
Shurik has finally assembled his robot girl, named her Emma, and given her a mind. And the incredible happened! Emma fell in love! With Semyon, of course. Well, how could you not fall in love with a guy like that, right? Emma has to win the heart of her chosen one, and the end, as they say, justifies the means.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1858342525]Steam[/url]]
translation:
舒里克终于组装了他的机器人女孩，给她命名为艾玛，并赋予了她心灵。令人难以置信的事情发生了！艾玛恋爱了！当然是和谢苗一起。好吧，你怎么能不爱上这样的人呢，对吧？艾玛必须赢得她所选择的人的心，正如人们所说，结果证明不择手段。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1858342525]Steam[/url]]
